name: Mystery of MILFs
source:
You will play as a young man to become a hero, adventure and save your family.
And of course, date the girls. It's up to you to become the heartbreaker or the king of the city.​
translation:
你将扮演一名年轻男子，踏上冒险征途、成长为英雄并拯救自己的家人。
当然，也少不了与女孩们约会恋爱。究竟是当个芳心纵火犯，还是加冕为整座城市的王者，一切全凭你做主。
